call_points.text: Mahad contrast media backward integration to commission later this calendar year, ahead of earlier H2 guidance.
Hyderabad R&D center first phase expected operational this month.
PI intermediate supply restarted after destocking; performance expected to sustain for FY27 on order visibility.
Three contrast media candidates expected to launch in FY27; pilot activities for a new high-intensity sweetener.
QIP completed, strengthening balance sheet and providing financial flexibility.
Contrast media revenue recognition depends on goods reaching customer location; transit delays can defer sales.
Inventory destocking in the pharma intermediates segment is complete, and order shipments have resumed.
Vizag greenfield expansion is underway with an outlay of approximately ₹1,000 Cr over 3 years.
Pharma Intermediate de-stocking and inventory normalization completed by customer with robust revenues expected in coming quarters.
Vizag Project ground-breaking completed and project activities have commenced.
R&D Centre Hyderabad civil construction commenced, targeted to complete on or before September 2026.
Secured trial orders in Advanced Contrast Media from a new Japanese customer.
Q4FY26 gross margin rose to 56% (vs 52% in Q3FY26) driven by favorable mix and higher Contrast Media sales.
FY26 Other Income rose to ~₹68.7 Cr from ~₹46.3 Cr in FY25, mainly driven by foreign exchange gains.

guidance.statement: Robust revenues expected backed by orders from PI segment in coming quarters
Expect double-digit growth in the contrast media segment for FY27 supported by new launches.
Expected capital expenditure for the next three years will be INR1,000-odd crores, with approximately INR250 crores in FY27.
guidance.target: ₹1,000-odd Cr over three years; ₹250 Cr in FY27

guidance.statement: Vizag Phase 1 investment of approximately INR1,000 crores over the next 3 years.

operating_notes.text: The company operates in a single reportable business segment comprising Artificial Sweeteners, Contrast Media Intermediates, Pharma Intermediates, and APIs.
Total reaction capacity reached 1,175.60 KL across 3 facilities in FY26.
Contrast media plant utilisation steady at 70-odd percent; production to dispatches at 100%.
Mahad project has ₹210 Cr invested with ₹40 Cr more committed; total asset addition expected over ₹200 Cr on commissioning.
Approximately 70% of energy consumption sourced through renewable energy (wind and solar).
